title: WKLY — Angular date and time picker
description: Explore six selection modes, localization, calendar adapters, validation, and inline, dialog or overlay presentations.

single.title: Date and time selections | WKLY Angular picker
single.description: Try the date picker, time picker, and combined date and time picker, with manual entry, seconds, and 12-hour or 24-hour time.

ranges.title: Date and time ranges | WKLY Angular picker
ranges.description: Try date range, time range, and date and time range selection, with automatic endpoint ordering and separate start and end times.

presentations.title: Inline, dialog and overlay presentations | WKLY Angular picker
presentations.description: Compare inline, native dialog, input-anchored CDK overlay, and Angular Material presentations, including confirm and cancel behavior.

localization.title: Localization and RTL | WKLY Angular picker
localization.description: Compare Hebrew, Arabic, and US English examples with translated labels, localized digits, RTL layouts, and regional week and clock formats.

calendars.title: Gregorian, Hebrew and Hijri calendars | WKLY Angular picker
calendars.description: Select a day in linked Gregorian, Hebrew, and civil Hijri calendars while preserving the same Gregorian UTC value.

validation.title: Validation and Angular forms | WKLY Angular picker
validation.description: Explore Angular forms validation, date and time bounds, disabled days, range constraints, and editable invalid manual input.

virtualization.title: Virtual scrolling calendar | WKLY Angular picker
virtualization.description: Compare full-month, surrounding-week, and compact four-week views, with continuous calendar scrolling and direct jumps across decades.

styling.title: Picker colors and sizing | WKLY Angular picker
styling.description: Compare green, indigo, dark, and larger picker styles using CSS color tokens and size multipliers with accessible touch targets.
